en: Sepia-toned vintage seaside scene showing people, including children and adults in early 20th‑century swimwear and clothing, enjoying a rocky shoreline. Some are standing near the water, others are seated on the rocks and grassy areas. A small boat is on the water in the distance. In the lower right corner, white printed text names the location as Vänersborg and describes bathing at Skräcklan.
